description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka  - Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka estimated  revenue expenditure for the year 2018
categorisation: This gazette contains the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka's estimated expenditure and activity budget for 2018, which falls under public sector financial administration and service planning. The content details budget allocations for personnel, operations, and specific public service activities, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a government structure/personnel matter (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories.
